title: A Dog, a Pan and a Pit
lines: Min and a dog sit at a pit. Sid is in the fog.
Sid and the dog tag in the fog.
The dog is not at the pit. It is not at a pot.
Min and Sid tap a pan in the fog.
The dog is at the pit!
Sid and it nap at the pit.
scoring_note: This passage says "is not", "it is". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "isn't" or "it's" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
